notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only the FFLOS detail page and the Forest Lookouts page were read for this tower. The Forest Lookouts quote does not say which of two 1910-11 towers stood on Sand Mountain, so the 1910 date is taken from FFLOS and the report is treated as consistent with it. The Forest Lookouts page also has a 1915 line about a tree observation post 25 feet high on the Penn Forest; it is left out because it may refer to Centre County II (a 1915 tree tower on FFLOS), not this site. The brief's coordinates (40.7831, -77.5669) are not supported by any page read, and FFLOS gives no coordinates. No removal date, staffing, fire, access or photo evidence found. A 1910-11 Department of Forestry report itself would be the best next source for design and fate. Not related: the Sandy Ridge tower in Centre County (Moshannon State Forest, built 1921) appeared in a search and is a different site.
